none: PAS CAM-5C8532: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy contemporary copy of a Radiate of Divus Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a Radiate of Divus Claudius II. AD275-285, (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads CONSECRATIO. Reverse shows Eagle left, head right. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Obverse legend reads DIVO CLAVDIO. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.17g, diameter is 16.8mm
